mapper.select: SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, up.tag_id, st.name AS tag_name, up.create_time FROM user_preference up LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON up.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN scenic_tag st ON up.tag_id = st.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.create_time FROM user_preference up LEFT JOIN scenic s ON (up.category_id = s.category_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scenic_tag_relation str WHERE str.scenic_id = s.id AND str.tag_id = up.tag_id )) LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.score DESC
